name: Vine Sweeper
notes: DRAFT for C13-1 (bestiary-plan.md). A tangle of vines that swings one long sweep. Stats set in R-BAL-8 (#183). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).

lore.yellow: The vines grew wild without the sun. Free them, and they curl back around the garden fence.
